title: We Found Out!
desc: Two little lines that changed everything — the moment we found out you were on your way.
story: It was the 2nd of June 2025, and nothing about that morning felt particularly extraordinary — until it was. We stared at that little test together, and there they were: two lines. Clear as anything. For a moment neither of us said a word. Then it hit us, all at once — there was a tiny life beginning, and it was ours. There were tears, there was laughter, and there were probably a few shaky hands. We had no idea of the adventure that was coming, but we already knew it would be the greatest one of our lives.
